//: The recommended TypeScript settings for a Blitsen application, published as
`blitsen/tsconfig.json`. Extend it and keep your own paths and strictness:
Nothing here is Blitsen-specific machinery. It says the few things
TypeScript cannot work out on its own:
lib/target — the engine in a current Blitsen runs ES2023. The DOM
entries are what makes `document` and friends resolve. Blitsen implements a
subset of the DOM, and `blitsen doctor` is what checks a build against that
subset; types cannot express it, so they do not try to.
module/moduleResolution — Blitsen runs the ES modules a bundler already
emitted, and resolves the `blitsen/*` subpaths through package exports,
types — explicit rather than inferred: an application with @types/node
